title: The Promise of a New Heart and the Gathering of Israel
description: The Lord's word comes to Ezekiel concerning the exiled Israelites, whom the people of Jerusalem had written off. God promises that although He has scattered them among the nations, He Himself has been a sanctuary for them. He will gather them back to the land of Israel, and they will remove their idols. He promises to give them one heart and a new spirit, to take away the heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh, so that they may follow His laws and be His people. But those who cling to idols will receive what their deeds deserve.
